checks.explanation: The Scarlett Johansson/OpenAI dispute never resulted in any equity or ownership stake for Johansson; OpenAI simply removed the disputed 'Sky' voice without a lawsuit, settlement payment, or ownership transfer.

OpenAI has tightened internal security significantly amid growing safety and espionage concerns through 2025-2026, but it has not become as closed and campus-culture-free as a classified intelligence agency; it retains much more openness than that comparison implies.
The Johansson/OpenAI dispute never reached litigation or generated new fair-use case law or legislation; OpenAI simply withdrew the 'Sky' voice, avoiding any court precedent being set.

The Johansson/OpenAI matter was resolved without any lawsuit ever being filed, and OpenAI removed the 'Sky' voice, consistent with the pattern of these disputes settling rather than reaching a court judgment.
No specific, verifiable record of formal regulatory interviews with the departed OpenAI superalignment team leaders producing major new public disclosures was found.

Venture and growth capital allocation to AI chips, semiconductors, and hardware infrastructure increased dramatically from 2024 through 2026, a well-documented major shift from the pre-2023 pattern of largely avoiding hardware investment.

Nvidia's overall AI compute market share remained dominant through 2025-2026, though competitors like AMD, Broadcom-based custom ASICs, and Google TPUs did gain some ground, providing partial but not decisive confirmation.

Nvidia expanded its own DGX Cloud and related compute-rental offerings through 2025-2026, moving somewhat into competing with hyperscalers, though it has not launched a full frontal assault rivaling AWS, GCP, or Azure at comparable scale.

Consumer and industry interest in low-plastic and bioplastic food packaging alternatives grew through the mid-2020s amid microplastic health concerns, though it remains a smaller niche trend rather than a dominant industry-wide shift.
The All-In Summit took place in Los Angeles September 8-10, 2024 as planned, with attendees present in person.
Scholarship tickets for the 2024 All-In Summit were announced and offered ahead of the event, as predicted.
No specific, verifiable record confirming a Las Vegas celebration party tied to the All-In YouTube channel hitting one million subscribers was found.
